programSaid.hint: Only a program IT has approved for this PC: its full path (an .exe), its SHA-256 exactly as IT gives it, and any arguments IT names, one per line. The app checks the file's SHA-256 before each start, holds the file so it cannot be changed while it starts, and starts it directly, without a command window or a script, and without this app's tokens. The check covers the .exe file itself, not files it loads, so IT should name a program in a folder only administrators can change, such as C:\Program Files. With nothing entered here, no program can be started.
programSaid.starts: This starts mcp-server.exe on this PC. Press again to start it.
programSaid.mcpHint: An MCP server offers tools that this app can call for you: a search, a lookup, a calculation. A server is reached over https:// (http:// for this PC only), or is a program on this PC that IT approved: added with “Add a program on this PC”, by its full path and the SHA-256 IT gives, which the app checks before each start; the app asks you before it starts the program, and stops it when you are done. Nothing is sent by itself: Test asks a server for its list of tools, and MCP tools (in the tray menu's More) shows you exactly what a call sends before you press Send. The token stays in the environment variable you name and is never saved by the app. A server's answer and its descriptions of its tools are shown as plain text and are never followed as instructions.
